summary: Round 7 verification — direct-start portfolio, textured Rocky model, stronger glass frame, and full World2 lifecycle. All targeted features PASSED. Backend /api/health 200; /models/rocky.glb serves 200 at 19,751,424 bytes (~19.75MB). Frontend: fresh load (sessionStorage cleared) shows Hero immediately, NO login-screen, NO boot-screen; scroll works instantly; hero-know-more anchor scrolls to interests section (scrollY 0→828). Rocky in space scene renders as stone-textured creature (visible face/eyes beside monitor at scrollY≈4400) — procedural fallback NOT visible. Scrolling further auto-boots World2: data-phase progression boot → login → desktop (after clicking login-enter-button). Stronger glass on Computer window visible. world2-exit lands on site-end-section with end-reopen-computer present and World2 fully closed (element removed). Rocky AI chat trigger present in World1. Mobile 390px: zero horizontal overflow across hero/interests/exploring/space/end. Zero console errors during full flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Regression item mentioned 'sound-toggle' and 'night-toggle' data-testids in World 1 — no such testids exist in World 1 DOM (only found inside World 2 taskbar as icons without testids). If sound/night controls should be discoverable outside World 2, add data-testid attributes; otherwise the review item wording is misleading and can be closed.

rocky.glb is 19.75MB and loads on initial page mount (SpaceScene mounts eagerly) — consider lazy-loading via IntersectionObserver on the space act to save mobile bandwidth for users who never scroll that far.
